artworks.title: Odysseus and the Sirens (the "Siren Vase")
artworks.description: Odyssey 12 on an Attic stamnos — the hero lashed to the mast while his crew rows past the meadow of bones, hearing the song that kills every man who reaches it unbound.

artworks.title: Odysseus and his men blinding Polyphemus (Eleusis Amphora, detail)
artworks.description: The oldest surviving Cyclops scene — Nobody's cunning stake earns Poseidon's endless enmity and ten more years of wandering before rocky Ithaca.
